replies.author: Rainstruck
replies.body:
In the rules section of the forums it says, "
  1. Abusing the report system (/report) will not be tolerated. Do not encourage others to report a specific player and do not repeatedly report the same user if a staff member has not attended to the report."
To learn more about the rules you can go to avicus.net/rules
